content.comment_body: Hi [user_name], I have a problem accessing parameters on [product_name] via the internet. I need to change settings remotely in the same way as done physically at the device using buttons like ESC and the cursor keys, to reach different parameters. What is the best approach, [product_name] App or the web interface? Thanks in advance.
You can use either the [product_name] App or the integrated webserver.

I need to achieve the functionality shown in these videos: [url], [url], [url]. Currently, I can't accomplish this via the web interface. Some parameters, like the weekly clock or time settings, cannot be changed through the web. Is there any way to modify them remotely? Thanks in advance.
Using the web interface, you cannot access the full menu of the [product_name]. To achieve parameter changes, you must input them via message text and ensure the option for "webserver" is enabled.
I've made a useful discovery. Thanks as always for your support.

analysis.insight_summary: Users experience restrictions when attempting to change certain parameters on [product_name] remotely through the web interface. Direct access through physical controls allows for more complete parameter modification, whereas remote interfaces like the web or app do not provide access to all settings, resulting in confusion and unmet needs.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect to be able to remotely access and modify all parameters on [product_name], including settings like the weekly clock and time, via the web interface or app, just as they can directly at the device.
